text: Their FTP note said "before every healthcare job". Somewhere on that survey of two hundred and fourteen is the next one, still on St. Catherine's build. We're checking them one at a time.
style: Professional intelligence handler in debrief. Speak with a consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Use a steady, mid-range pitch.
